window.note: Fixed for edition 001 (founder brief, 16 October 2026). The 30 complete days before the first collection date. A later rebuild or a later evidence pass must not move it; build.py uses these dates and checks that every collected post falls inside them and every collection happened after the end date.

window_rule: Fixed window recorded above. For later editions the rule is the last 30 complete calendar days in America/Toronto before the first collection date, written into edition.json when collection starts and never recomputed.

fields.affected_evidence: list of record ids, files or posts the review covers
fields.why_usable: why the remaining observation is still usable
fields.permitted_claims: list of claims the page may make
fields.prohibited_claims: list of claims that stay prohibited; must rule out frequency, window totals and that the observed posts are all the account published
fields.reviewer: the person who reviewed it (not a tool or build)

reviewed_limitations_schema.rule: A reviewed limitation clears only that coverage gap in the release report. It never turns unknown identity, incomplete coverage or missing activity into a verified fact: social.json keeps its coverage status and the page keeps its incomplete-sample wording. Founder entries only.

forms_script_readiness.required: status 'verified' needs the deployed Apps Script version or revision, its deployment time, and a check by a person that a lead carrying entry_point research_dental reached the intended lead record (sheet tab and row or another record reference). Source changes, build or unit tests and frontend analytics events never count.
